article.title: Immunotherapy for Melanoma: A Breakthrough

abstract.p: Melanoma, a deadly form of skin cancer, has seen treatment paradigms shift with the advent of immunotherapy. Immune checkpoint inhibitors, such as anti-PD-1 and anti-CTLA-4 antibodies, have shown remarkable efficacy. This paper explores the mechanisms of action and clinical outcomes associated with these therapies. The future may involve combination strategies to overcome resistance.
